name: Cubicsofts Phone Order Tracker for Asaan Retail
author: cubicsofts

sections.description:
Order Tracking by Phone for Asaan Retail allows WooCommerce store owners to sync delivery status from Asaan Retail and lets customers track their orders using phone number.

Developed by Cubicsofts (https://cubicsofts.com).

Features

  • Sync WooCommerce orders with Asaan Retail
  • Phone-based order tracking
  • Optimized hash-based syncing
  • Secure AJAX tracking
  • Custom database table (fast & scalable)
  • Admin panel for synced orders
  • WP-Cron background syncing

Author

Talha Tabani
Company: Cubicsofts
Website: https://cubicsofts.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Configure Asaan API credentials
  4. Add shortcode [asaan_phone_tracker] to any page
